summary.text: Joe D'Orsie is a Republican state representative from Pennsylvania House District 47 who took office on December 1, 2022, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A York, Pennsylvania native, he worked as communications director for Praise Community Church.

paragraphs.text: D'Orsie was born in York, Pennsylvania, and earned a bachelor's degree from Duquesne University in 2008.

His career experience includes working as a communications director for Praise Community Church, and he has been affiliated with the York Young Republicans, Praise Community Church and the American Legion.
D'Orsie succeeded Keith Gillespie in District 47, and in the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the House Education and Labor & Industry committees.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he wrote that his primary goal as a legislator was to reverse abortion-rights policies, and that he favored reducing the size of state government with low taxes and limited regulation.
Democrat Edward Ritter is his opponent on the November 3, 2026 ballot.
